QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_14

question.text: Operating expenses (statutory, legal, audit, communication, etc.) in a typical AIF are capped at what range, as indicated in Ch 9?

answer.text: 1 to 5 basis points of NAV or commitments per annum
100 to 500 basis points of NAV or commitments per annum
10 to 50 basis points of NAV or commitments per annum
Uncapped — all expenses are on actuals

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 9.1: Operating expenses are typically capped at 10-50 bps of NAV or capital commitments (higher of the two), computed yearly. The Trap: Option A is unrealistically tight. Option B (1%-5%) is too high and overlaps with management fee. Option D confuses with Transaction Expenses. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B tests the cap; XIX-C requires the manager to negotiate the base (NAV vs commitments 'higher of'). Manager's Pro-Tip: The 'higher of NAV or commitments' base protects the GP early in the fund life (when NAV might be low post-expenses) but after harvesting, NAV typically dominates. Include a carve-out for one-off extraordinary expenses (major litigation, regulatory action) subject to LPAC approval.
